Itemized Passive Description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Changes Ki Spheres for 7 turns: PHY to AGL, TEQ or STR
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Changes Ki Spheres: INT to AGL, TEQ or STR
- Receives an additional Ki +2 per Type Ki Sphere obtained
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Seals the attacked enemy's Super Attack
*Per "Earthlings" or "DB Saga" Category ally on the team
(depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 150%)
- Damage reduction rate 5%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 25%)
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
*With an AGL Ki Sphere obtained*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- All allies' ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Attacks are effective against all Types
*With a TEQ Ki Sphere obtained*
- DEF 350%{passiveImg:up_g}
- All allies' DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Great chance of evading enemy's attack
*With a STR Ki Sphere obtained*
- ATK 350%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Performs a critical hit
- Interrupts the attacked enemy
- Survives K.O. attacks (up to once within a turn)
*When there is an enemy whose name includes "Goku"
(Captain Ginyu, Jr., etc. excluded)*
- {passiveImg:once}Changes Ki Spheres: All to AGL, TEQ & STR
